paper_source.anchor: Section 5.2, Table 2; Appendix Table 5 (S5.SS2, S5.T2, A1.T5)

exact_scope: Matched flat-SVL-versus-re-evaluated-CRL performance comparison on HumanoidMaze-giant using the same depth-6 DDPG+BC actor, preregistered seeds 0-3, identical data and evaluation protocol, 1,000,000 updates, 50 evaluation episodes per seed, raw seed outputs, and independently reconstructed uncertainty.
decision_basis: C6 requires new matched performance outputs; paper values and source inspection alone cannot verify the comparison.
The pinned HSVL release registers only the hierarchical HSVL agent with high and low actors and contains no flat-SVL implementation or flat-agent registry entry.
The pinned OGBench release contains its benchmark CRL agent, but that does not identify the paper's re-evaluated CRL variant with the paper-matched depth-6 DDPG+BC actor.
Even with a faithful recovered implementation, both arms require four 1,000,000-update HumanoidMaze-giant runs and are accelerator-scale.
blockers: The exact flat SVL implementation and paper-matched re-evaluated CRL actor are not present in the pinned public releases, so the required method pairing cannot be reconstructed without unsupported invention.
Faithful four-seed HumanoidMaze-giant training is GPU-bound, but every GPU flavor is forbidden by campaign policy.
A source-only, reduced-update, reduced-seed, or CPU toy comparison would not be performance evidence.
next_step: Stop C6 as BLOCKED. Do not launch local training, HF cpu-upgrade, or GPU work; reopen only if exact paper-matched flat SVL and CRL source becomes available together with an authorized faithful compute route.
